title: Restore whole first-node setup ownership on source rejection
body:
The retained PR2697 Consumer prepares its directory, odometer, geometry and layout before entering the original cleanup block. Fixed-register exhaustion during actual width64/rank1/depth2/mod3 preparation can therefore leave newly owned arena slots live. This package wraps the entire setup interval, restores borrowed source ownership on admitted pre-handoff ValueErrors, and delegates to the unchanged packet engine after removing its hooks.

The proof covers partial constructors and all setup allocation categories, bounded weak live-Tape bookkeeping, retained numerical backing, and a metered cleanup bound in failure-time extent. Fourteen actual-caller controls cover the two reproduced inventory failures, malformed records and a partial Callback, constructor boundaries, one/two old-prefix success, and post-handoff exceptions. An omitted-rollback implementation mutant and boolean receipt counter are rejected. Original sources and attribution remain pinned and unchanged.

Validation: direct normal and optimized CPython3.12 replay plus registered metadata/pin checks, source-history preflight, official export integrity, fresh Git-free CPython3.12 replay, missing/changed source rejection, and independent narrow source/proof review. Exact commands and receipts are provided in the package and delivery evidence.

Scope: reachable source-array ownership only. Python deallocation is not physical bytezeroization. Host allocation failures, concurrent runtime use, malicious mutation and post-handoff rollback are excluded. Cleanup is bounded by retained extent at failure; no entry-parametric whole-preparation time theorem, full selected GL64 payload execution, physical compiler, recursive/outer admission or selected-frontier change is claimed.

Complete receipt comparison also rejects a nested integer-to-float substitution. The final checker-only delta was checked in normal mode and through a fresh final optimized cold replay; the scientific source and receipt are unchanged. The aggregate registration wrapper was not rerun.

Prepared by JoyboyBrian with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Original contributor attribution and Apache-2.0 notices are retained.
